structure: Part 8, copied addresses (animals journey and the INS address book behind it). Read in full: the three spec files addresses-copied.spec.ts (4 tests), addresses-edit.spec.ts (6 tests) and addresses-submit-freeze.spec.ts (2 tests) under repos/trade-imports-ins-tests/tests/animals/e2e/features/address-book/, and all 12 trace zips the partition names, every one passed. tim distil trace 'open' refused the traces (TraceVersionError: recorded by a newer Playwright), so, as the partition structure directs, each zip was read already unzipped in the part folder (trace-e2e.work/part8/<hash>/): every browser action from the N-trace.trace files (before events: goto, click, fill, check, selectOption, reload, expect), the rendered <main> of every frame snapshot (rendered to <hash>.main.html), the address book API calls and bodies in N-trace.network and resources/, and the test steps in test.trace. Refs below name the trace by its folder hash (b00d3, 0db17, 8eb85, 7de00 from addresses-copied; 923fb, e4503, 435a1, ecf01, bb8eb, 5c999 from addresses-edit; 4d3c6, db5da from addresses-submit-freeze) and the browser call id. Pages reached, in journey order: dashboard (/live-animals) and start of a notification (b00d3, 0db17 only, unseeded); Overview task list; Consignment addresses hub (/addresses, caption 'Consignment parties'), one summary-list row per role (Place of origin, Consignor or exporter, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination, County parish holding (CPH) number) with Add, or Change plus Edit details; the role picker (/consignors/select, /place-of-origin/select; heading = role name, search, a 5-per-page table of book records, pagination, 'Selected address:' inset); the edit-address form (/<role>/edit?return=addresses|notification-view, /consignment/contact/edit?return=consignment%2Fcontact%2Fselect; caption = role, heading 'Edit address details'); Contact address for consignment (/consignment/contact/select: radios of every book record plus a 'Current contact address' card); Review your notification (/notification-view) in Draft, Submitted and Amending states, incl. its error summary and per-row error; Declaration; Import notification submitted confirmation; dashboard search and Amend notification; Overview in Amending; Cancel this amendment? (/cancel-amend); review after cancelling (?cancelled=1 with a success banner). Conditional surface: Edit details only for a role holding a copy; Add only for an unanswered role; review error summary only when a copy breaks the rules or a section is incomplete; Change/Edit links and Continue absent on a submitted notification. Seeded tests (createDraftNotification) built the draft over HTTP form posts in a separate request context; only the UI part is browser-walked. Not reached: the contact edit form's error state, any validation other than name, postcode length, email format and country, a no-results picker search page render, editing a copy during an amendment, and what reaches the backend (server-side calls are not in a browser trace).

claims.quote: /addresses?change=1 ... /place-of-origin/select?change=1

claims.statement: Every journey page shows a journey strip above the content with the status tag (Draft blue, Submitted green, Amending yellow) and the notification reference in bold; it is an app-specific component (app-journey-strip) built from govuk-tag and govuk-body.
claims.quote: DraftGBN-AG-26-0TXX5N

claims.statement: The role picker and the contact page link out to the INS address book frontend to add a new address, passing the journey type, notification id, a fulfilment id and a handshake token.
claims.ref: trace 8eb85 action call@107 ('Add a new address' href); ecf01 call@120 after
claims.quote: http://localhost:3002/address-book/add?journey-type=gbn-ag&notification-id=GBN-AG-26-AQ2R7S&fulfilment-id=9ad1e2f3-a4b5-4c60-8d1c-9e0f1a2b3c4d&handshake-token=[REDACTED]

claims.statement: Every journey form posts a hidden concurrencyToken (a version number of the notification) alongside the CSRF crumb, so saves carry the version they were read at.
claims.ref: trace 923fb call@167 after and call@171 after (concurrencyToken 17), call@185 after (18)
claims.quote: <INPUT type="hidden" name="concurrencyToken" value="17">
claims.note: Inferred from the field name and that it rises after a save; no conflict was driven. Crumb values redacted by omission.

claims.statement: The picker lists book records five per page with a caption 'Showing 5 of N addresses', a table of Name, Address and Country, a small radio per row labelled 'Select <name>' (visually hidden) and a 'View details' disclosure with every field.
claims.quote: Showing 5 of 27 addresses
claims.note: Picker detail belongs to the picker part; recorded because the deleted-record behaviour is read through it.

claims.statement: No trace shows the picker's search results when the search matches nothing (after the deleted record is searched for), so the no-results copy is unknown.
claims.ref: trace 8eb85 actions call@153-call@157: no frame snapshot after the search

claims.statement: The contact address edit form's error state is never driven, so whether it uses the same messages as the role edit form is not shown.
claims.ref: traces ecf01, 5c999: contact edit saved valid or cancelled only

claims.statement: No trace drives a blank address line 1, blank town or city, blank postcode, blank phone, blank email or an over-long field on the edit form, so whether those are required and their messages are not shown.
claims.ref: trace 435a1: only name, postcode length, email format and country driven

claims.statement: No trace edits a copied address during an amendment and then cancels the amendment, so whether the edit is discarded with the amendment is not shown.
claims.ref: traces 4d3c6, db5da: amendment opened and cancelled without edits

claims.statement: No trace shows which address rules a copy can break other than an unlisted country, nor the review message for more than one broken role.
claims.ref: trace 7de00: one broken role, country only

claims.statement: No trace shows whether the picker pre-selects the source record after its copy has been edited on the notification.
claims.ref: traces 923fb, e4503: picker not reopened after an edit

claims.statement: The traces do not show the calls the frontend makes to the backend or the address book when copying or editing an address (they are server-side), so how the copy is stored is not shown.
claims.ref: all 12 traces: only browser and test-fixture traffic recorded
